name: Lytics
description: Lytics is a customer data platform for collecting and resolving customer data, building behavioral audiences, personalizing experiences, and activating data across marketing destinations. It combines identity resolution, audience segmentation, content affinity, reporting, journeys, integrations, and warehouse-connected data workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated customer-owned Lytics token with only account-scoped Audience View permission; agents can read only identity-free user, content, and public segment counts.

credentialRequirements.name: LYTICS_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Lytics API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated token with only the account-scoped v2_segment_view permission. Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the Authorization header to api.lytics.io.

capabilities.label: Read segment readiness summary
capabilities.description: Aggregate user, content, and public segment counts while excluding segment identity, definitions, membership sizes, lineage, jobs, and profile data.

approvalRequired.label: Get Lytics segment readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only returned, user, content, and public segment counts from the account-wide segment list.

blocked.label: Access segment identity, definition, or size
blocked.description: Segment IDs, names, slugs, descriptions, SegmentQL/AST, membership sizes, metadata, groups, ancestry, jobs, and timestamps remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, identities, events, or content
blocked.description: Users, profiles, identities, devices, events, fields, streams, content documents, affinities, recommendations, PII, consent, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access connections, journeys, or activation
blocked.description: Connections, authorizations, destinations, exports, imports, jobs, journeys, campaigns, experiences, reports, flows, templates, and activation state remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer Lytics
blocked.description: Segment/group creation or mutation, reevaluation, users, roles, tokens, settings, schemas, streams, queries, integrations, publishing, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API, scans, or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, inputs, account selectors, filters, scans, profile/entity reads, pagination, polling, retries, CLI/SDK, browser sessions, Collect/bulk ingestion, exports, and raw responses remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded segment readiness read requires approval; identity, definitions, profiles, activation, writes, administration, scans, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; token authority, account scope, redaction, response cap, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed identity-free Lytics segment readiness wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed Lytics wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: Lytics API access requires an eligible customer account, an administrator-created dedicated token with v2_segment_view and no PII permission, and live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer administrator creates a dedicated expiring least-privilege token, confirms its account and Audience View role, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Lytics documents account-wide GET /v2/segment plus detailed segment reads, create/update/delete, reevaluation, ancestry, jobs, and groups; Relay selects only the list read.
Lytics documents the exact GET https://api.lytics.io/v2/segment endpoint and Authorization-header credentials.
Lytics documents administrator-created access tokens with roles, selectable expiration, one-time secret display, and deletion.
Lytics documents account-scoped v2_segment_view Audience View permission, separate manage and PII permissions, and no per-resource or workspace scoping.

securityNotes: Relay encrypts the customer-owned token and sends it only as the Authorization header to api.lytics.io; the token is never returned to agents.
Relay requires a dedicated account-scoped v2_segment_view token without PII View and allowlists only GET /v2/segment.
Relay rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps the response at 1 MB, accepts no runtime input, and never follows pagination or retries automatically.
Output contains only returned, user, content, and public segment counts; segment IDs, names, slugs, definitions, sizes, metadata, groups, ancestry, jobs, and profiles are excluded.

Detailed segment reads, scans, profiles, content, connections, journeys, activation, writes, reevaluation, administration, raw APIs, CLI/SDK, browser sessions, Collect/bulk ingestion, and exports remain blocked.
Token creation, role/expiration selection, account confirmation, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
